domain.smallest_target: 0 (approached as the burden grows; no clinical maximum burden is declared)

statement.B_range: (0, 1 + k b0], strictly decreasing in b, exactly 1 at b = b0, maximum 1 + k b0 at b = 0
statement.C_range: [1 / (1 + g s0), (1 + g) / (1 + g s0)], non-decreasing in s
statement.b_domain: b in [0, inf): the state domain of aux.vasodilatory_burden (no clinical maximum is declared)
statement.independence: s reads delivery and demand (derived.acute_deficit_signal), b is written by a family and read nowhere else: neither factor reads the other, so the reachable set is the product of the ranges
statement.infimum: 0, approached as b grows without bound; not attained
statement.insufficiency: with a distributive reader declared, 1 + g (the published admissibility check) sees neither Bmax nor a severe burden, and g a < 1 does not scale with Bmax: both were insufficient exactly where the distributive factor is active
statement.loop: T -> afterload A(T) = 1 / (1 + a (T - 1)) -> output -> delivery -> s -> target -> T_next, one minute behind
statement.maximum: C_max x B_max = (1 + g) (1 + k b0) / (1 + g s0), at s = 1 (no effective delivery) and b = 0
statement.monotonicity: non-decreasing in s, strictly decreasing in b; the two are independent, so the extremes are the products of the extremes
statement.p2j2_bound: g a < 1 is this bound with B = 1 and the A(T_lo) / (1 + g s0) factor dropped; it was published as a profile invariant and is NOT reopened here
statement.s_domain: s in [0, 1]: effective_oxygen_deficit is max(0, demand - reserve x delivery) over demand
statement.slope: d(target)/dT = B(b) x [g / (1 + g s0)] x a x A(T) x (1 - s) on the active deficit branch, 0 off it: from s(T) = max(0, 1 - mu A(T)) with mu = reserve x arrival_delivery_ratio x K / demand (K the part of delivery that does not read T), so ds/dT = mu a A(T)^2 = (1 - s) a A(T)
statement.slope_bound: (1 + k b0) g a A(T_lo) / (1 + g s0), with T_lo the lower end of the supported range: (1 - s) <= 1, B(b) <= 1 + k b0 and A is decreasing
statement.target: tone_target = C(s) x B(b), C(s) = (1 + g s) / (1 + g s0), B(b) = (1 + k b0) / (1 + k b)
statement.where_the_guards_are_hit: above, when C_max x Bmax > T's upper guard (reached by resolution, b -> 0); below, when C(s) B(b) < T's lower guard (reached by a severe burden)

criteria: 1. b < b0 is explicit and coherent: the factor rises to exactly 1 + k b0 as the arrival vasodilation resolves, and it is declared as recovery, not as a vasopressor signal (X1-X4, the derivation)
2. no negative burden: the state, the arrival anchor and a writer's minute all refuse it, and the contract says it is not vasoconstriction (X5)
3. the upper and lower reachable domains fail closed instead of letting the channel's clamp shape physiology (X6, X7, X8)
4. the contraction guard covers the distributive factor, derived from the common equations, and holds for every accepted witness (X9, X10, the derivation)
5. no pressure-driven family vasodilation loop exists, and the writer contract forbids one (X15)
6. every prior family remains exact by default, and the predecessor's behaviour is reproduced with the one declared supersession (X11, X12, X13, X14)
7. TD-120 is formally superseded without rewriting history (the supersession record)
8. the Phase-2 debt classes are explicit, and no item is a blocker merely because it is UNSET
9. no known causal contradiction remains inside the certified Phase-2 scope

decisions.1_below_arrival_burden: BELOW_ARRIVAL_BURDEN = ALLOWED_RECOVERY: b < b0 is the resolution of the arrival distributive vasodilation, physiologically allowed and not a generic vasopressor signal; the maximum recovery is at b = 0, so Bmax = 1 + k b0. T rising above the arrival-relative 1 is not a reason to reject it
decisions.2_no_negative_burden: the burden stays at or above 0; a writer never resolves it below physiologic zero and a negative burden is NOT vasoconstriction (a vasopressor acts through its own mechanism)
decisions.3_guards_include_the_factor: the upper-target admissibility and the contraction analysis of the delayed T loop must both account for Bmax = 1 + k b0: the full reachable target under the declared domain must stay inside the range for which the architecture claims the guard does not shape physiology
decisions.4_fail_closed: TONE_CLAMP_AS_PHYSIOLOGY = REJECTED: a declared parameter / state combination whose tone target would leave the supported domain fails closed (CoreInvariantError, this repository's semantic boundary) before execution instead of being clamped into shape; the channel guard remains the last safety layer but is never the expected clinical response
decisions.5_no_pressure_driven_writer: PRESSURE_DRIVEN_FAMILY_VASODILATION = DEFERRED / NOT_AUTHORIZED: a family writer of the burden may not read the current MAP, pressure_rel, T or another same-loop haemodynamic observable; allowed inputs are its disease-process state, time, a treatment and authored family mechanisms
decisions.6_maldistribution: the distributive CRT / lactate direction is FUTURE_RESEARCH_DEBT, not a Phase-2 blocker: no MIGRATED_AND_CERTIFIED family writes the burden and anaphylaxis is not required for exit; no maldistribution, extraction heterogeneity, distributive CRT or distributive lactate model is implemented here
decisions.7_anaphylaxis_gaps: plasma leak without red-cell loss, maldistribution / extraction, upper-airway and stridor representation, a pharmacologic chronotropic target, epinephrine kinetics and the anaphylaxis parameter regions are POST-PHASE2 / FAMILY-MIGRATION work
decisions.8_p2s3: TD120_HISTORICAL_SUPERSESSION_ACCEPTED: the historical P2S-3 frozen package, its sources and its digest are not recut or rewritten; the operative result is declared superseded by P2T-3
decisions.scope: a closure package: no new clinical physiology, no magnitude, no new canonical state, no runtime integration, no Phase 3
